title: Diagnostic Fixture - Intentional Unresolved CURRENT Handle
creativeIntent: This file is intentionally schema-valid but CURRENT-invalid. It exists only to prove that the Simple Preview reports unresolved handles clearly and never silently substitutes a visually similar asset.

beats.storyClaim: An intentionally nonexistent ship handle is requested so strict diagnostics can be verified.

camera.subject: missing_ship
camera.purpose: The preview must show UNRESOLVED CURRENT HANDLE and must not pick another ship.

beats.evidence: Expected result is a clear blocker diagnostic. Any substituted visual means the preview failed this fixture.
